title: Qwen2.5 Release
summary: The Qwen Team publicly introduced Qwen2.5 on September 19, 2024 and described the release as including Qwen2.5 language models alongside Qwen2.5-Coder and Qwen2.5-Math model families.
significance: A documented public release milestone in the Qwen model family, with multiple open-weight model sizes and specialized coding and mathematics variants released together.

verification.note: The Qwen Team's first-party September 19, 2024 release post directly establishes the introduction/release date and identifies the Qwen2.5, Qwen2.5-Coder and Qwen2.5-Math families. The date is attached only to this documented public-release event; no development date, geography, ancestry, influence, causal relationship or unsupported precision is inferred.
